description: Match a veteran's military service era and deployment location to PACT Act 2022 presumptive conditions. Returns all presumptive conditions the veteran qualifies for (no medical proof needed for presumptives — service + location is enough). Also generates VA Form 20-0995 Supplemental Claim filing guidance.

deployment_country.description: Country of deployment (Iraq, Afghanistan, Vietnam, Kuwait, etc.)

era.description: Combat era; use "any" to return all PACT Act presumptives

symptoms.description: Free-text symptoms or conditions to match (e.g. "respiratory problems, cancer")

name: match_pact_presumptive
title: PACT Act presumptive conditions
